# Each explicitly selected source retries for at most 180 days. No on_action,
# global scan, teleportation, ship recreation or ship deletion is used.
fleet_event = {
 id = auto_qol_reassembly.20
 hide_window = yes
 is_triggered_only = yes
 immediate = {
  if = {
   limit = {
    has_fleet_flag = auto_qol_reassembly_active
    exists = owner
    owner = { is_ai = no }
    exists = event_target:auto_qol_reassembly_destination
    auto_qol_reassembly_worker_source = yes
    event_target:auto_qol_reassembly_destination = {
     auto_qol_reassembly_owned_military = yes
     is_owned_by = root.owner
     is_controlled_by = root.owner
    }
   }
   set_variable = { which = auto_qol_reassembly_room value = owner.trigger:command_limit }
   subtract_variable = { which = auto_qol_reassembly_room value = event_target:auto_qol_reassembly_destination.trigger:fleet_size }
   if = {
    limit = {
     is_in_combat = no
     event_target:auto_qol_reassembly_destination = { is_in_combat = no }
     solar_system = { is_same_value = event_target:auto_qol_reassembly_destination.solar_system }
     fleet_size <= auto_qol_reassembly_room
    }
    # Uses the native action, preserving ships and normal merge restrictions.
    # Exact target filter prevents nearest-fleet guesses.
    clear_orders = yes
    queue_actions = {
     find_closest_fleet = {
      trigger = {
       id = "auto_qol_reassembly_exact_destination"
       is_same_value = root.event_target:auto_qol_reassembly_destination
      }
      found_fleet = { merge_fleet = { target = this } }
     }
    }
    remove_fleet_flag = auto_qol_reassembly_active
   }
   else = { fleet_event = { id = auto_qol_reassembly.20 days = 5 } }
   clear_variable = auto_qol_reassembly_room
  }
  else = { remove_fleet_flag = auto_qol_reassembly_active }
 }
}
